newsitem.title: GERMANY: German chemical firms H1 data seen positive.
newsitem.headline: German chemical firms H1 data seen positive.

text.p: Analysts expect a generally solid picture from the Big Three German chemical firms' interim earnings reports this week and next, although market leader Hoechst AG's data will be distorted by special factors.
Overall, analysts said the reports will show the chemical groups profiting from the deutschemark's decline against the dollar this year and from lively foreign demand.

But analysts warned that the strong first half which all three firms experienced last year would limit their growth potential, while a series of unit sales and acquisitions would distort the earnings picture at Hoechst.
Hoechst reports first-half earnings on Wednesday, BASF AG follows on Thursday and Bayer AG is due to release results on August 19.
Analysts polled by Reuters are predicting sales at Hoechst of between 26.35 billion marks ($14.3 billion) and 27.2 billion, up from 26.09 billion in the year-ago period.
Hoechst pre-tax profits are seen at between 1.93 billion marks and 2.05 billion after extraordinary earnings inflated its profit in the year-earlier period to 4.32 billion.
However analysts cautioned that Hoechst's earnings were difficult to forecast. Its operating profit growth would be the best of the Big Three, they predicted.
BASF AG, on the other hand, is seen posting the best earnings and sales data of its history.
Analysts are forecasting sales growth of 13.3 percent to 14.6 percent -- to 27.5 to 27.8 billion marks -- and a pre-tax profit of between 2.46 and 2.53 billion marks, up 5.9 to nine percent.
Bayer is expected to post pre-tax profit of 2.8 to 2.86 billion marks, marking an increase of 2.6 to five percent.
Bayer's sales are expected to rise to 26.5 to 26.9 billion marks from 24.80 billion marks in the year-ago period, for an advance of between 6.9 and 8.1 percent.
The company has benefited from good foreign demand, analysts said, while expansion costs weigh on its pharmaceuticals business.
